title: Unit header
description: A 64px white bar with a hairline under it that stays pinned to the top: a bold lowercase wordmark, four quiet menu links, then a plain text link and a hairline pill button on the right. Links dim to 60% on hover. On phones a 50px bar with the wordmark and a menu icon that opens a full-height list.
notes: sticks to the top (position: sticky), so place it directly in the page container
the phone menu is a native <details>; no JavaScript
name: unit-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the wordmark, set in lowercase type

props.name: links
props.description: the main menu (left, after the wordmark)

props.name: secondary
props.description: a plain text link before the button (e.g. a sandbox)

props.name: cta
props.description: the outline pill at the far right

props.name: menuLabel
